intro: Insulated steel-clad garden rooms from a Dublin company, with no timber in the exterior, built to the size and layout each garden needs.
standfirst: Garden Room Ireland's own photographs of finished rooms in clients' gardens: dark, green and oak finishes, on lawns, decks and slopes.
interiorsText: The same rooms fitted out for different lives. Every photograph is the supplier's own.

products.name: QC6
products.summary: Garden Room Ireland's fuller-specification steel-clad garden room, built to the size and layout you choose, with options including flyover roofs, half or picture windows and doors in any position.
specs: From 6 × 6 ft up to 12 × 33 ft; external width just over 4 m
Leatherette-embossed galvanised steel walls, uPVC and glass windows, EPDM roof; no timber
Described by the supplier as insulated to live, sleep and eat in; no U-value published
25-year exterior guarantee, as stated by the supplier (terms not published)

products.name: QCB (Quarter Century Building)
products.summary: A timber-free, steel-clad insulated garden office supplied on its own adjustable base, so a concrete base is not needed on a clear site.
specs: 2750 × 2750, 4000 × 2750 and 5200 × 2750 mm (internal); other sizes on request
100 mm Ecotherm; A-rated double-glazed sealed units
Supplied and installed by Garden Room Ireland, in a day by the supplier's account
25-year exterior guarantee, as stated by the supplier (terms not published)

products.name: L-Shape Living Annex
products.summary: An L-shaped annex fitted as standard with a bedroom, living space, wardrobes, shower, sinks, toilet and kitchen.
specs: 3 m or 4 m; length and floor area not published
Galvanised steel walls, uPVC and glass windows, EPDM roof

productsNote: Specifications as Garden Room Ireland publishes them on its website. PlotNua has not changed or added to them. Every room is quoted to its size and configuration, so each is shown here as price on enquiry until Garden Room Ireland confirms current prices.
planningNote: Whether planning permission is needed depends on the room's size, where it sits and how it will be used. Ireland's exemption for garden buildings does not extend to use as a separate home, so an annex with a bedroom, kitchen and shower needs particular care. Check your plans with your local authority before you commit.
